text:
Samir Patel: Heads up — pricing change for Pro tier goes live Monday. New rate limits: 80k tokens/min per account (down from 120k). Early estimate: ~18% of Pro customers may migrate to Dedicated or start bursting, which could add ~450 GPU hours/week in us-west-2 for Q3 if we don’t provision ahead. Thoughts?

Alex Chen: Data to back the 18%?

Samir Patel: Quick breakdown I used: short, approximate -- not final.
Samir Patel: ```
sample_accounts = 200
avg_tokens_min = 15000
mins_per_day = 30
gpu_hours_per_token = 1e-7  # crude conversion from tokens to GPU-hours for our inference profile
weekly_gpu_hours = sample_accounts * avg_tokens_min * mins_per_day * 7 * gpu_hours_per_token
print(weekly_gpu_hours)  # ~450
```

Priya Nair: OK that's a reasonable back-of-envelope. Two follow-ups: (1) how many of those accounts are multi-region? we can't shift all load to eu-west if they’re us-only, (2) any seasonality in Q3 we should factor? last year we saw a promo in late July that bumped usage for ~9 days.

Jules Rivera: @capacity-bot can you run a similarity check vs the July promo spike and return the 90th-percentile delta?

capacity-bot: similarity-scan scheduled. Found 2024-07-22..2024-07-31 spike: baseline x1.6 for 9 days across hosted, concentrated 72% in us-west-2 and 18% in eu-west-1. 90th-percentile weekly GPU increase: +520 hours.

Samir Patel: That aligns — our quick calc is conservative vs the historical promo. Important note: customers who hit the new rate limit often start parallelizing requests (more connections, same token rate) which increases concurrency and raises our peak GPU need even if aggregated token rate is similar.

Alex Chen: Region constraints: we only have 40 A100 equivalents precommitted in us-west-2 this quarter. If we need +20 for a week that's a problem. Can we use burstable capacity from dedicated pools in us-east-1 and route? Networking + latency might be bad for some customers.

Priya Nair: Routing cross-region will impact tail latency. Recommend: pre-allocate 12 GPUs in us-west-2 and set routing policy to allow spillover to us-east-1 for non-SLA customers. Also configure auto-fallthrough to smaller models (quantized) to save GPU-hours.

Maya Ortiz: From finance POV, what's the incremental cost of pre-allocating 12 A100s for two weeks vs. paying for burst usage? Ballpark numbers please (we need to decide by EOD).

Samir Patel: Ballpark: pre-alloc 12 A100s @ reserved weekly effective cost ≈ $18k/week. Bursting ad-hoc at cloud list ~ $36k/week (est). So reservation wins if spike lasts > ~3 days.

Jules Rivera: Also think about customer packaging: could we temporarily raise burst quotas for enterprise customers who ask and push PLG users to a soft cap with a message? That reduces cold-start of provisioning.

Priya Nair: Action items: (1) Samir to open a provisioning request for +12 A100s in us-west-2 for two weeks (start Mon), (2) Alex to add a routing policy that prefers us-west-2, spills to us-east-1 for non-SLA, (3) Jules to draft a comms snippet for PLG users explaining temporary rate limits and upgrade path.

Samir Patel: I'll file the request now and tag @Maya for budget sign-off. If capacity-bot shows anything worse than the promo pattern we'll escalate to full Dedicated outreach. :thumbsup:

capacity-bot: provisioning-request created: PR-8732. Estimated impact if approved: +12 A100s allocated to us-west-2 starting 1749883200 for 14 days.

Maya Ortiz: Approved provisional spend for up to $40k for this event; will reconcile with actuals. Please submit final estimate once PR is accepted.

Samir Patel: Thanks — will update thread with PR link and exact costs.

Alex Chen: Minor note: add a canary to the routing change so we don't shift sensitive tenants.

Priya Nair: I'll own the canary rollout and monitoring runbook.

Samir Patel: Great — closing loop here. If anyone sees a sharp uptick in the metrics (token-rate or connection count) ping this thread immediately.
